title: Tradeborn Realms
about: Trade on a fantasy exchange where noble houses, regions, routes, and commodities rise and fall with the living world's fortunes.

The listings are not invented. Every instrument is backed by a real entity in the world of Mytherra — a house whose prestige rises and falls with the renown of its living heirs, a region whose granaries empty in a famine, a mine that a war closes. The chronicle is your newspaper; the fundamentals underneath it are your research.

You cannot touch the world. You can only read it faster and better than the next broker. Positions settle on the world's clock, not yours — and a century-long era ends in a cataclysm that has never once been priced in correctly.
